content:
As of **2024**, the estimated population of the **United States** is approximately **335–337 million people**, based on data from the **U.S. Census Bureau** and **United Nations projections**.

### **Key Details:**
- **2023 Census Estimate:** ~**334.9 million** (as of July 1, 2023)
- **2020 Census (Official Count):** **331.4 million**
- **Growth Rate:** ~**0.5% per year** (slower than historical trends due to lower birth rates and reduced immigration)
- **3rd Most Populous Country** (after **China** and **India**)

### **Sources:**
- [U.S. Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/)
- [World Bank](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?locations=US)
- [United Nations World Population Prospects](https://population.un.org/wpp/)

Would you like a breakdown by state or more historical data?
